name: Google
hook: The search engine that became a verb — founders, Doodles and the companies it owns.

facts.label: Larry Page & Sergey Brin
facts.statement: Larry Page and Sergey Brin founded Google in 1998 while Ph.D. students at Stanford; the name was chosen to imply a vast reach.

facts.label: Google Doodle
facts.statement: Google's homepage marks holidays with Doodles; Wes Craven created one for Halloween 2008.

facts.label: Alphabet
facts.statement: Alphabet is the holding company that owns Google, headed by Larry Page and Sergey Brin.

facts.label: Android
facts.statement: Android is Google's mobile operating system, named for a humanoid robot.

facts.label: Chrome
facts.statement: Google unveiled its Chrome web browser in September 2008.

facts.label: Google Earth
facts.statement: Google bought Keyhole in 2004; its mapping technology became Google Earth.

facts.label: Waymo
facts.statement: Waymo is Google's self-driving car unit, testing driverless rides in Phoenix.
